import pygame, subprocess, sys, os
from belentani_engine import *

GAMES=[('1','SERPIENTE TRILINGUE'),('2','PLATAFORMAS DEL VOCABULO'),('3','INVASORES DE SINTAXIS'),
       ('4','FLAPPY BELENTANI'),('5','CAE EL IDIOMA'),('6','AHORCADO DEL GUERRERO')]
def main():
    pygame.init(); screen=pygame.display.set_mode((W,H))
    pygame.display.set_caption('BELENTANI AI · ARCADE')
    clock=pygame.time.Clock()
    f30=pygame.font.SysFont('arial',30,bold=True); f20=pygame.font.SysFont('arial',20,bold=True)
    f15=pygame.font.SysFont('arial',15,bold=True)
    while True:
        t=pygame.time.get_ticks()
        for e in pygame.event.get():
            if e.type==pygame.QUIT: pygame.quit(); return
            if e.type==pygame.KEYDOWN:
                for k,_ in GAMES:
                    if e.key==getattr(pygame,'K_'+k):
                        subprocess.run([sys.executable,'play.py',k]); 
            if e.type==pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:
                for i,(k,_) in enumerate(GAMES):
                    r=pygame.Rect(W//2-260,150+i*58,520,50)
                    if r.collidepoint(e.pos): subprocess.run([sys.executable,'play.py',k])
        liquid_bg(screen,t)
        draw_bel(screen,120,110,140,t)
        text(screen,'BELENTANI AI · ARCADE EDUCATIVO',W//2,60,f30)
        text(screen,'Guerreiro & Cantante · ES / CA / EN / MATES',W//2,92,f15,PINK)
        m=pygame.mouse.get_pos()
        for i,(k,n) in enumerate(GAMES):

            text(screen,f"[{k}]  {n}",W//2,r.centery,f20)
        tops=top_scores()
        if tops: text(screen,'  |  '.join(f"{g}: {s}" for g,s in tops[:4]),W//2,H-20,f15,PINK)
        pygame.display.flip(); clock.tick(30)

if __name__=='__main__': main()

open('image2motion_turntable.py','w',encoding='utf-8').write('''"""BELENTANI IMAGE-2-MOTION: hoja de referencia (4 vistas) -> turntable GIF + ciclo de caminado.
Corta closeup/frente/perfil/espalda y hace crossfade rotatorio con pulso de luz."""
import math, os
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance

SRC=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','belentani_sheet.png')
OUT=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','sprites')

def crop_views(img):
    w,h=img.size
    boxes={'close':(0.0,0.0,0.38,1.0),'front':(0.38,0.0,0.63,1.0),
           'side':(0.63,0.0,0.81,1.0),'back':(0.81,0.0,1.0,1.0)}
    return {k:img.crop((int(a*w),int(b*h),int(c*w),int(d*h))) for k,(a,b,c,d) in boxes.items()}

def turntable(views, frames_per=8, size=(360,480)):
    seq=['front','side','back','side']
    vs={k:v.resize(size) for k,v in views.items()}
    frames=[]
    for i,name in enumerate(seq):
        a=vs[name]; b=vs[seq[(i+1)%len(seq)]]
        for f in range(frames_per):
            al=f/frames_per; e=al*al*(3-2*al)
            fr=Image.blend(a,b,e)
            fr=ImageEnhance.Brightness(fr).enhance(1.0+0.06*math.sin(al*math.pi))
            frames.append(fr)
    return frames

def walk_cycle(frames, bob=10, n=12):
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        ph=i/n*2*math.pi
        fr=frames[int(i/n*len(frames))%len(frames)]
        canvas=Image.new('RGB',fr.size,(22,1,4))
        canvas.paste(fr,(int(4*math.sin(ph)),int(bob*abs(math.sin(ph)))))
        out.append(canvas)
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
    img=Image.open(SRC).convert('RGB')
    tt=turntable(crop_views(img))
    wk=walk_cycle(tt)
    tt[0].save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_turntable.gif'),save_all=True,append_images=tt[1:],duration=60,loop=0)
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(wk[0].width*6,wk[0].height*2))
    for i,fr in enumerate(wk): sheet.paste(fr,((i%6)*wk[0].width,(i//6)*wk[0].height))
    sheet.save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_walk.png'))
    print('OK turntable frames:',len(tt),'| walk frames:',len(wk))
''')

import pygame, random
from belentani_engine import *

COLS,ROWS,CS=21,13,40; OX,OY=(W-COLS*CS)//2,70
def gen_maze(cols,rows):
    grid=[[1]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    stack=[(1,1)]; grid[1][1]=0
    while stack:
        c,r=stack[-1]; opts=[]
        for dc,dr in ((2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)):
            nc,nr=c+dc,r+dr
            if 0<nc<cols-1 and 0<nr<rows-1 and grid[nr][nc]==1:
                opts.append((nc,nr,c+dc//2,r+dr//2))
        if opts:
            nc,nr,wc,wr=random.choice(opts)
            grid[nr][nc]=0; grid[wr][wc]=0; stack.append((nc,nr))
        else: stack.pop()
    return grid
class MazeInstitut(BaseGame):
    NAME='MAZE INSTITUT'
    def setup(self):
        self.g=gen_maze(COLS,ROWS)
        self.pc,self.pr=1,1
        cells=[(c,r) for r in range(1,ROWS,2) for c in range(1,COLS,2) if not self.g[r][c] and (c,r)!=(1,1)]
        random.shuffle(cells)
        self.words=random.sample(CONTENT['ff'],4)
        self.gems=[[self.words[i],cells[i],True] for i in range(3)]
        self.trap=[self.words[3],cells[3],True]
        self.exit=(COLS-2,ROWS-2)
        self.g[ROWS-2][COLS-2]=0; self.g[ROWS-2][COLS-3]=0
    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type!=pygame.KEYDOWN: return
        d={pygame.K_UP:(0,-1),pygame.K_DOWN:(0,1),pygame.K_LEFT:(-1,0),pygame.K_RIGHT:(1,0)}.get(e.key)
        if not d: return
        nc,nr=self.pc+d[0],self.pr+d[1]
        if 0<=nc<COLS and 0<=nr<ROWS and not self.g[nr][nc]:
            self.pc,self.pr=nc,nr; self.check()
    def check(self):
        for gm in self.gems:
            if gm[2] and (self.pc,self.pr)==gm[1]:
                gm[2]=False; self.score+=150; self.add_streak(); self.hits+=1; self.total+=1; say(gm[0]['es'])
        tr=self.trap
        if tr[2] and (self.pc,self.pr)==tr[1]:
            tr[2]=False; self.lives-=1; self.streak=0; self.total+=1
            if self.lives<=0: self.running=False
        if (self.pc,self.pr)==self.exit:
            if not sum(1 for gm in self.gems if gm[2]):
                self.score+=400; self.hits+=1; self.total+=1; self.running=False
            else: self.score=max(0,self.score-10)
    def draw(self,t):
        liquid_bg(self.screen,t)
        self.screen.blit(glass(W-20,44,22,40),(10,8))
        left=sum(1 for gm in self.gems if gm[2])

open('snake_trilingue.py','w',encoding='utf-8').write('''"""Come la traduccion CORRECTA (verde), evita el falso amigo (rojo)."""
import pygame, random
from belentani_engine import *
CELL=24; COLS=W//CELL; ROWS=(H-60)//CELL; TOP=60
class SnakeTrilingue(BaseGame):
    NAME='SERPIENTE TRILINGUE'
    def setup(self):
        self.snake=[(10,10),(9,10),(8,10)]; self.dir=(1,0); self.nd=(1,0)
        self.acc=0; self.speed=0.12; self.prompt_new(); self.place()
    def prompt_new(self): self.p=random.choice(CONTENT['ff'])
    def place(self):
        free=[(c,r) for c in range(COLS) for r in range(ROWS) if (c,r) not in self.snake]
        random.shuffle(free); self.good=free[0]; self.bad=free[1]
    def on_event(self,e):
        m={pygame.K_UP:(0,-1),pygame.K_DOWN:(0,1),pygame.K_LEFT:(-1,0),pygame.K_RIGHT:(1,0)}
        if e.type==pygame.KEYDOWN and e.key in m:
            d=m[e.key]
            if (d[0]+self.dir[0],d[1]+self.dir[1])!=(0,0): self.nd=d
    def update(self,dt,t):
        self.acc+=dt
        if self.acc<self.speed: return
        self.acc=0; self.dir=self.nd
        h=(self.snake[0][0]+self.dir[0],self.snake[0][1]+self.dir[1])
        if not(0<=h[0]<COLS and 0<=h[1]<ROWS) or h in self.snake:
            self.lives-=1; self.streak=0
            if self.lives<=0: self.running=False; return
            self.snake=[(10,10),(9,10),(8,10)]; self.dir=(1,0); self.nd=(1,0); return
        self.snake.insert(0,h)
        if h==self.good:
            self.score+=100; self.add_streak(); self.hits+=1; self.total+=1
            say(self.p['es']); self.prompt_new(); self.place()
            self.speed=max(0.07,self.speed-0.004)
        elif h==self.bad:
            self.lives-=1; self.streak=0; self.total+=1
            if self.lives<=0: self.running=False; return
            self.place()
        else: self.snake.pop()
    def chip(self,cell,word,color):
        x,y=cell[0]*CELL+CELL//2,TOP+cell[1]*CELL+CELL//2
        pygame.draw.circle(self.screen,color,(x,y),CELL//2-1)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.screen,(255,255,255),(x-4,y-5),3)
        im=self.f18.render(word,True,WHITE); self.screen.blit(im,im.get_rect(center=(x,y-CELL)))
    def draw(self,t):
        liquid_bg(self.screen,t)
        self.screen.blit(glass(W-20,44,22,40),(10,8))
        text(self.screen,f"PT '{self.p['pt']}'  ->  come la traduccion CORRECTA",W//2,30,self.f22)
        for i,(c,r) in enumerate(self.snake):
            col=(255,120,140) if i==0 else CRIM
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen,col,(c*CELL+CELL//2,TOP+r*CELL+CELL//2),CELL//2-2)
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen,(255,255,255),(c*CELL+CELL//2-4,TOP+r*CELL+CELL//2-5),3)
        self.chip(self.good,self.p['es'],GOOD)
        self.chip(self.bad,self.p['trap'],BAD)
        self.hud(t)
if __name__=='__main__': SnakeTrilingue().run()
''')

from belentani_engine import *
class Plataformas(BaseGame):
    NAME='PLATAFORMAS DEL VOCABULO'
    def setup(self):
        self.px,self.py=60,300; self.vx=0.0; self.vy=0.0; self.on=True; self.cam=0; self.won=False
        self.plats=[(0,420,500,26),(420,340,260,22),(760,300,240,22),
                    (1080,380,300,24),(1460,300,260,22),(1800,420,600,26)]

    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type==pygame.KEYDOWN and e.key in (pygame.K_SPACE,pygame.K_w,pygame.K_UP) and self.on:
            self.vy=-640; self.on=False
    def update(self,dt,t):
        k=pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.vx=((k[pygame.K_d] or k[pygame.K_RIGHT])-(k[pygame.K_a] or k[pygame.K_LEFT]))*320
        self.vy+=1500*dt
        self.px+=self.vx*dt; self.py+=self.vy*dt

        for (x,y,w,h) in self.plats:
            if x<=self.px<=x+w and self.py+60>=y and self.py+60<=y+h+18 and self.vy>=0:

        if abs(self.px-self.flag[0])<45 and not self.won:
            self.won=True; self.score+=300; self.hits+=1; self.total+=1; self.running=False
        self.cam=max(0,min(self.px-W//2,2400-W))
    def draw(self,t):

        for g in self.gems:
            if g[3]: continue

            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen,(255,255,255),(sx-4,gy-5),4)
            text(self.screen,g[0]['es'],sx,g[2]-32,self.f18)
        for tr in self.traps:

            sx=tr[1]-self.cam
            pygame.draw.polygon(self.screen,BAD,[(sx-14,tr[2]+16),(sx+14,tr[2]+16),(sx,tr[2]-16)])
            text(self.screen,tr[0]['trap'],sx,tr[2]-34,self.f18,BAD)
        fx=self.flag[0]-self.cam
        pygame.draw.line(self.screen,WHITE,(fx,self.flag[1]),(fx,self.flag[1]-95),4)

import pygame, random
from belentani_engine import *
class Flappy(BaseGame):
    NAME='FLAPPY BELENTANI'
    def setup(self):
        self.y=H//2; self.v=0; self.gates=[]; self.next_x=W+220; self.speed=150
        self.prompt_new()
    def prompt_new(self): self.p=random.choice(CONTENT['ff'])
    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type==pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN or (e.type==pygame.KEYDOWN and e.key==pygame.K_SPACE):
            self.v=-370
    def update(self,dt,t):
        self.v+=900*dt; self.y=min(max(30,self.y+self.v*dt),H-30)
        for g in self.gates: g['x']-=self.speed*dt
        self.next_x-=self.speed*dt
        if self.next_x<W+120:
            ok_top=random.random()<0.5
            self.gates.append({'x':self.next_x,
                'y1':random.randint(110,200),'y2':random.randint(340,430),
                'w1':self.p['es'] if ok_top else self.p['trap'],
                'w2':self.p['trap'] if ok_top else self.p['es'],'done':False})
            self.next_x+=540
        for g in self.gates:
            if not g['done'] and g['x']<=120:
                g['done']=True; self.total+=1
                in1=abs(self.y-g['y1'])<62; in2=abs(self.y-g['y2'])<62
                if in1 or in2:
                    word=g['w1'] if in1 else g['w2']
                    if word==self.p['es']:
                        self.score+=150; self.add_streak(); self.hits+=1; say(word); self.prompt_new()
                    else: self.lives-=1; self.streak=0
                else: self.lives-=1; self.streak=0
                if self.lives<=0: self.running=False
        self.gates=[g for g in self.gates if g['x']>-80]
    def wall(self,x,y0,y1):
        if y1>y0: self.screen.blit(glass(46,max(10,y1-y0),12,40),(x-23,y0))

        for g in self.gates:
            self.wall(g['x'],0,g['y1']-62)

open('ahorcado_guerrero.py','w',encoding='utf-8').write('''"""Adivinha a palavra ES com pista PT; a cada erro a armadura de Belentani racha."""
import pygame, random
from belentani_engine import *
class Ahorcado(BaseGame):
    NAME='AHORCADO DEL GUERRERO'
    def setup(self):
        self.words=[(c['es'],c['pt']) for c in CONTENT['concepts']]+[
            ('escoba','vassoura'),('apellido','sobrenome'),('raro','esquisito'),
            ('avergonzada','embaracada'),('taller','oficina'),('raton','rato')]
        self.rounds=0; self.new_word()
    def new_word(self):
        self.w,self.hint=random.choice(self.words); self.w=self.w.upper()
        self.tried=set(); self.err=0
    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type!=pygame.KEYDOWN: return
        ch=pygame.key.name(e.key).upper()
        if len(ch)!=1 or not('A'<=ch<='Z') or ch in self.tried: return
        self.tried.add(ch); self.total+=1
        if ch in self.w:
            self.hits+=1; self.score+=50
            if all(c in self.tried for c in self.w if c.isalpha()):
                self.score+=200; self.add_streak(); self.rounds+=1; say(self.w.lower()); self.new_word()
        else:
            self.err+=1; self.streak=0
            if self.err>=6:
                self.lives-=1
                if self.lives<=0: self.running=False; return
                self.new_word()
    def draw(self,t):
        liquid_bg(self.screen,t)
        self.screen.blit(glass(W-20,44,22,40),(10,8))
        text(self.screen,f"Pista PT: '{self.hint}'  ->  adivinha a palavra ES",W//2,30,self.f22)
        draw_bel(self.screen,150,250,180,t)
        for i in range(self.err):
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen,BAD,(95+i*18,175),(135+i*20,335),3)
        text(self.screen,f"Erros: {self.err}/6",150,375,self.f18,BAD)
        n=len(self.w); x0=W//2-(n*34)//2
        for i,c in enumerate(self.w):
            x=x0+i*34
            shown=c if (c in self.tried or not c.isalpha()) else '_'
            text(self.screen,shown,x,H-130,self.f40)
            pygame.draw.line(self.screen,CRIM,(x-14,H-104),(x+14,H-104),3)
        text(self.screen,' '.join(sorted(self.tried)) or '-',W//2,H-40,self.f18,PINK)
        self.hud(t)
if __name__=='__main__': Ahorcado().run()
''')

import math, os
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance

SRC=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','belentani_sheet.png')
OUT=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','sprites')

def crop_views(img):
    w,h=img.size
    boxes={'close':(0.0,0.0,0.38,1.0),'front':(0.38,0.0,0.63,1.0),
           'side':(0.63,0.0,0.81,1.0),'back':(0.81,0.0,1.0,1.0)}
    return {k:img.crop((int(a*w),int(b*h),int(c*w),int(d*h))) for k,(a,b,c,d) in boxes.items()}

def turntable(views, frames_per=8, size=(360,480)):
    seq=['front','side','back','side']
    vs={k:v.resize(size) for k,v in views.items()}
    frames=[]
    for i,name in enumerate(seq):
        a=vs[name]; b=vs[seq[(i+1)%len(seq)]]
        for f in range(frames_per):
            al=f/frames_per; e=al*al*(3-2*al)
            fr=Image.blend(a,b,e)
            fr=ImageEnhance.Brightness(fr).enhance(1.0+0.06*math.sin(al*math.pi))
            frames.append(fr)
    return frames

def walk_cycle(frames, bob=10, n=12):
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        ph=i/n*2*math.pi
        fr=frames[int(i/n*len(frames))%len(frames)]
        canvas=Image.new('RGB',fr.size,(22,1,4))
        canvas.paste(fr,(int(4*math.sin(ph)),int(bob*abs(math.sin(ph)))))
        out.append(canvas)
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
    img=Image.open(SRC).convert('RGB')
    tt=turntable(crop_views(img))
    wk=walk_cycle(tt)
    tt[0].save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_turntable.gif'),save_all=True,append_images=tt[1:],duration=60,loop=0)
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(wk[0].width*6,wk[0].height*2))
    for i,fr in enumerate(wk): sheet.paste(fr,((i%6)*wk[0].width,(i//6)*wk[0].height))
    sheet.save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_walk.png'))
    print('OK turntable frames:',len(tt),'| walk frames:',len(wk))

```python
"""BELENTANI IMAGE-2-MOTION: hoja de referencia (4 vistas) -> turntable GIF + ciclo de caminado."""
import math, os
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance

SRC=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','belentani_sheet.png')
OUT=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','sprites')

def crop_views(img):
    w,h=img.size
    boxes={'close':(0.0,0.0,0.38,1.0),'front':(0.38,0.0,0.63,1.0),
           'side':(0.63,0.0,0.81,1.0),'back':(0.81,0.0,1.0,1.0)}
    return {k:img.crop((int(a*w),int(b*h),int(c*w),int(d*h))) for k,(a,b,c,d) in boxes.items()}

def turntable(views, frames_per=8, size=(360,480)):
    seq=['front','side','back','side']
    vs={k:v.resize(size) for k,v in views.items()}
    frames=[]
    for i,name in enumerate(seq):
        a=vs[name]; b=vs[seq[(i+1)%len(seq)]]
        for f in range(frames_per):
            al=f/frames_per; e=al*al*(3-2*al)
            fr=Image.blend(a,b,e)
            fr=ImageEnhance.Brightness(fr).enhance(1.0+0.06*math.sin(al*math.pi))
            frames.append(fr)
    return frames

def walk_cycle(frames, bob=10, n=12):
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        ph=i/n*2*math.pi
        fr=frames[int(i/n*len(frames))%len(frames)]
        canvas=Image.new('RGB',fr.size,(22,1,4))
        canvas.paste(fr,(int(4*math.sin(ph)),int(bob*abs(math.sin(ph)))))
        out.append(canvas)
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
    img=Image.open(SRC).convert('RGB')
    tt=turntable(crop_views(img))
    wk=walk_cycle(tt)
    tt[0].save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_turntable.gif'),save_all=True,append_images=tt[1:],duration=60,loop=0)
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(wk[0].width*6,wk[0].height*2))
    for i,fr in enumerate(wk): sheet.paste(fr,((i%6)*wk[0].width,(i//6)*wk[0].height))
    sheet.save(os.path.join(OUT,'belentani_walk.png'))
    print('OK turntable frames:',len(tt),'| walk frames:',len(wk))

# adapt_2048_mates.py — (inspirado en 2048, MIT)
"""2048 MATES: fusiona tiles hasta crear el tile-objetivo de la ecuacion."""
import pygame, random
from belentani_engine import *

N=4; TS=105; OX=(W-N*TS)//2; OY=95
class Mates2048(BaseGame):
    NAME='2048 MATES'
    def setup(self):
        self.g=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
        self.add(); self.add(); self.new_eq()
    def add(self):
        empty=[(r,c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N) if not self.g[r][c]]
        if empty:
            r,c=random.choice(empty); self.g[r][c]=random.choice([2,2,2,4])
    def new_eq(self):
        self.target=random.choice([4,8,16,32])
        a=random.randint(1,self.target-1)
        self.eq=f"{a} + {self.target-a} = ?"
    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type!=pygame.KEYDOWN: return
        d={pygame.K_LEFT:'L',pygame.K_RIGHT:'R',pygame.K_UP:'U',pygame.K_DOWN:'D'}.get(e.key)
        if d: self.move(d)
    def line(self,row):
        xs=[x for x in row if x]; out=[]; i=0
        while i<len(xs):
            if i+1<len(xs) and xs[i]==xs[i+1]:
                v=xs[i]*2; out.append(v); self.score+=v; self.hits+=1; self.total+=1
                if v==self.target:
                    self.add_streak(); self.score+=300; say(str(v)); self.new_eq()
                else: self.streak=0
                i+=2
            else: out.append(xs[i]); i+=1
        return out+[0]*(N-len(out))
    def move(self,d):
        old=[r[:] for r in self.g]
        if d=='L': self.g=[self.line(r) for r in self.g]
        if d=='R': self.g=[self.line(r[::-1])[::-1] for r in self.g]
        if d in ('U','D'):
            self.g=[list(x) for x in zip(*self.g)]
            if d=='U': self.g=[self.line(r) for r in self.g]
            else: self.g=[self.line(r[::-1])[::-1] for r in self.g]
            self.g=[list(x) for x in zip(*self.g)]
        if self.g!=old:
            self.add()
            if not self.can_move(): self.running=False
    def can_move(self):
        for r in range(N):
            for c in range(N):
                if not self.g[r][c]: return True
                if c+1<N and self.g[r][c]==self.g[r][c+1]: return True
                if r+1<N and self.g[r][c]==self.g[r+1][c]: return True
        return False
    def draw(self,t):
        liquid_bg(self.screen,t)
        self.screen.blit(glass(W-20,50,24,40),(10,8))
        text(self.screen,f"Objetivo: crea el tile {self.target}   ({self.eq})",W//2,33,self.f22)
        for r in range(N):
            for c in range(N):
                v=self.g[r][c]; x,y=OX+c*TS,OY+r*TS; sel=v==self.target
                self.screen.blit(glass(TS-8,TS-8,14,60 if sel else 26),(x+4,y+4))
                if v: text(self.screen,str(v),x+TS//2,y+TS//2,self.f30,CRIM if sel else WHITE)
        self.hud(t)

if __name__=='__main__': Mates2048().run()

"""MAZE INSTITUT: laberinto del instituto; recoge 3 traducciones y llega al AULA."""

COLS,ROWS,CS=21,13,40; OX,OY=(W-COLS*CS)//2,70
def gen_maze(cols,rows):
    grid=[[1]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    stack=[(1,1)]; grid[1][1]=0
    while stack:
        c,r=stack[-1]; opts=[]
        for dc,dr in ((2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)):
            nc,nr=c+dc,r+dr
            if 0<nc<cols-1 and 0<nr<rows-1 and grid[nr][nc]==1:
                opts.append((nc,nr,c+dc//2,r+dr//2))
        if opts:
            nc,nr,wc,wr=random.choice(opts)
            grid[nr][nc]=0; grid[wr][wc]=0; stack.append((nc,nr))
        else: stack.pop()
    return grid
class MazeInstitut(BaseGame):

        self.g=gen_maze(COLS,ROWS)

    def check(self):

# 🎬 BELENTANI MAX RENDER — RENDER CINEMÁTICO MÁXIMO

Motor de render por capas con **supersampling 2x, bloom aditivo, aberración cromática, partículas de brasa, caustics de luz líquida, barrido especular, grano fílmico, letterbox, subtítulos trilingües y 6 escenas dirigidas** (INTRO → TURNTABLE → WALK → CANTAR → COMBAT → TORMENTA). Exporta **GIF, frames PNG, MP4 y póster 1920×1080**, con granja de benchmarks por preset y reproductor in-game (juego #11 del Store).

---

## 1) `belentani_max_render.py` — NÚCLEO DE RENDER + EXPORT

```python
"""BELENTANI MAX RENDER: supersampling, bloom, aberracion cromatica, particulas,
caustics, barrido especular, grano, letterbox, subtítulos ES/CA/EN/PT y export GIF/MP4/poster."""
import pygame, math, random, os, sys, subprocess
from belentani_engine import W, H, CRIM, WHITE, PINK, belentani, text as etext

try:
    import numpy as np
    HAS_NUMPY=True
except Exception:
    HAS_NUMPY=False

PRESETS={'LOW':{'ss':1,'parts':40,'bloom':False,'ca':0,'grain':False},
         'MED':{'ss':1,'parts':120,'bloom':True,'ca':1,'grain':False},
         'ULTRA':{'ss':2,'parts':260,'bloom':True,'ca':2,'grain':True},
         'MAX':{'ss':2,'parts':420,'bloom':True,'ca':3,'grain':True}}

TIMELINE=[('INTRO',0,4),('TURNTABLE',4,8),('WALK',8,12),
          ('CANTAR',12,16),('COMBAT',16,20),('TORMENTA',20,24)]
SUBS={'INTRO':[('pt','Um guerreiro chega...'),('es','Un guerrero llega...')],
      'TURNTABLE':[('ca','Belentani, el guerrer carmesí')],
      'WALK':[('es','Camina entre lenguas...'),('en','Walking between languages...')],
      'CANTAR':[('es','Belentani canta tu idioma'),('ca','Belentani canta el teu idioma'),('en','Belentani sings your language')],
      'COMBAT':[('es','¡Tajo carmesí! Falsos amigos fuera')],
      'TORMENTA':[('pt','A tempestade de palavras passa...'),('es','La tormenta de palabras pasa...')]}

class MaxRender:
    def __init__(self, preset='MAX', seed=7):
        self.p=PRESETS[preset]; self.preset=preset; self.ss=self.p['ss']
        random.seed(seed)
        self.WW,self.HH=W*self.ss,H*self.ss
        self.world=pygame.Surface((self.WW,self.HH))
        self.ch=380*self.ss
        self.views=self._views()
        self.embers=[self._ember() for _ in range(self.p['parts'])]
        self.rain=[{'x':random.randint(0,self.WW),'y':random.randint(0,self.HH),
                    'v':random.randint(900,1400)*self.ss} for _ in range(140*self.ss)]
        self.noise=[self._noise() for _ in range(4)]
        self.bg=self._bg()
    def _sheet_surf(self):
        p=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'assets','belentani_sheet.png')
        if not os.path.exists(p): return None
        try:
            img=pygame.image.load(p).convert_alpha()
            return pygame.transform.smoothscale(img,(1200*self.ss,750*self.ss))
        except Exception: return None
    def _views(self):
        sh=self._sheet_surf(); boxes={'front':(.38,.63),'side':(.63,.81),'back':(.81,1.0)}
        out={}
        for k,(a,b) in boxes.items():
            if sh:
                r=pygame.Rect(int(a*sh.get_width()),0,int((b-a)*sh.get_width()),sh.get_height())
                sub=sh.subsurface(r)
                sc=min(self.ch/sub.get_height(), self.ch/sub.get_height())
                out[k]=pygame.transform.smoothscale(sub,(max(1,int(sub.get_width()*sc)),self.ch))
            else:
                out[k]=belentani(self.ch)
        return out
    def _ember(self):
        return {'x':random.randint(0,self.WW),'y':random.randint(0,self.HH),
                'vx':random.randint(-30,30)*self.ss,'vy':-random.randint(40,120)*self.ss,
                'r':random.randint(2,6)*self.ss,'ph':random.random()*6.28}
    def _noise(self):
        s=pygame.Surface((W//2,H//2),pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for _ in range(220):
            s.set_at((random.randint(0,W//2-1),random.randint(0,H//2-1)),(255,255,255,14))
        return s
    def _bg(self):
        s=pygame.Surface((self.WW,self.HH))
        for y in range(self.HH):
            f=y/self.HH
            s.fill((max(0,int(46-30*f)),int(2+4*f),max(0,int(12-8*f))),(0,y,self.WW,1))
        return s
    # ---------- capas ----------
    def _caustics(self,s,t):
        for i in range(5):
            y=int(self.HH*(0.15+0.18*i)+math.sin(t*0.8+i)*40*self.ss)
            pygame.draw.ellipse(s,(255,45,85),( -200,self.HH//2-300+i*40, self.WW+400, 600),1)
            pygame.draw.line(s,(255,60,90),(-10,y),(self.WW+10,y+int(30*math.sin(t+i))),max(1,2*self.ss))
    def _embers(self,s,dt):
        for e in self.embers:
            e['x']+=e['vx']*dt; e['y']+=e['vy']*dt
            if e['y']<-10 or e['x']<-10 or e['x']>self.WW+10: e.update(self._ember()); e['y']=self.HH+10
            a=0.5+0.5*math.sin(e['ph']+pygame.time.get_ticks()*0.004)
            pygame.draw.circle(s,(255,int(60+120*a),90),(int(e['x']),int(e['y'])),e['r'],0,pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD) if False else pygame.draw.circle(s,(int(90*a),int(20*a),int(25*a)),(int(e['x']),int(e['y'])),e['r'])
    def _sweep(self,s,cx,cy,w,h,t):
        band=pygame.Surface((90*self.ss,h),pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for x in range(band.get_width()):
            a=int(70*(1-abs(x-band.get_width()/2)/(band.get_width()/2)))
            pygame.draw.line(band,(255,255,255,a),(x,0),(x,h))
        sx=cx-w/2+((t*140*self.ss)%(w+180*self.ss))-90*self.ss
        s.blit(band,(int(sx),int(cy-h/2)),special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD)
    def _char(self,s,view,cx,cy,bob=0,scale=1.0,flip=False):
        im=self.views[view]
        if scale!=1.0: im=pygame.transform.smoothscale(im,(max(1,int(im.get_width()*scale)),max(1,int(im.get_height()*scale))))
        if flip: im=pygame.transform.flip(im,True,False)
        s.blit(im,(int(cx-im.get_width()/2),int(cy-im.get_height()/2+bob)))
        return im.get_width(),im.get_height()
    # ---------- escenas ----------
    def scene(self,s,t,dt):
        name=self._scene_name(t)
        cx,cy=self.WW//2,int(self.HH*0.62)
        if name=='INTRO':
            k=min(1,(t-0)/3.0); sc=1.5-0.5*k
            self._char(s,'front',cx,cy+int(60*self.ss*(1-k)),0,sc)
            if k>0.6:
                pygame.draw.rect(s,(200,16,46,120),(self.WW//2-320*self.ss,int(self.HH*0.12),640*self.ss,90*self.ss),border_radius=30*self.ss)
                etext(s,'BELENTANI',self.WW//2,int(self.HH*0.12)+45*self.ss,pygame.font.SysFont('arial',64*self.ss,bold=True))
        elif name=='TURNTABLE':
            seq=['front','side','back','side']; k=(t-4)/4*4
            i=int(k)%4; f=k-int(k)
            self._char(s,seq[i],cx,cy)
            nxt=pygame.Surface((self.WW,self.HH),pygame.SRCALPHA)
            self._char(nxt,seq[(i+1)%4],cx,cy)
            nxt.set_alpha(int(255*f*f*(3-2*f)))
            s.blit(nxt,(0,0))
        elif name=='WALK':
            bob=abs(math.sin(t*6))*14*self.ss
            self._char(s,'side',cx,cy-bob,0,1.0,flip=(int(t)%8)<4)
            for i in range(6):
                px=cx-((t*300*self.ss+i*160*self.ss)%(self.WW+200))+100
                pygame.draw.line(s,(120,10,26),(int(px),self.HH-40*self.ss),(int(px)-60*self.ss,self.HH-40*self.ss),6*self.ss)
        elif name=='CANTAR':
            pulse=0.5+0.5*math.sin(t*7)
            self._char(s,'front',cx,cy-int(pulse*8*self.ss))
            for i in range(24):
                bh=int((30+120*abs(math.sin(t*5+i*0.7)))*self.ss)
                pygame.draw.rect(s,(255,45,85),(int(self.WW*0.18+i*28*self.ss),self.HH-60*self.ss-bh,int(14*self.ss),bh),border_radius=6*self.ss)
            pygame.draw.circle(s,(255,120,150),(cx,cy-int(self.ch*0.32)),int(26*self.ss*(0.6+pulse*0.6)),3*self.ss)
        elif name=='COMBAT':
            shake=int(6*self.ss) if (t%2)<0.25 else 0
            ox=random.randint(-shake,shake); oy=random.randint(-shake,shake)
            self._char(s,'front',cx+ox,cy+oy)
            if (t%2)<0.4:
                pygame.draw.arc(s,(255,80,110),(cx-260*self.ss,cy-260*self.ss,520*self.ss,520*self.ss),-0.7,0.9,int(14*self.ss))
                for _ in range(14):
                    a=random.random()*6.28; r=random.randint(120,260)*self.ss
                    pygame.draw.circle(s,(255,180,190),(int(cx+math.cos(a)*r),int(cy+math.sin(a)*r)),3*self.ss)
        else:  # TORMENTA
            self._char(s,'back',cx,cy)
            for r in self.rain:
                r['y']+=r['v']*dt
                if r['y']>self.HH: r['y']=-20; r['x']=random.randint(0,self.WW)
                pygame.draw.line(s,(180,60,80),(r['x'],r['y']),(r['x']-6*self.ss,r['y']+26*self.ss),max(1,self.ss))
            if (t%3)<0.12:
                fl=pygame.Surface((self.WW,self.HH),pygame.SRCALPHA); fl.fill((255,220,230,110)); s.blit(fl,(0,0))
                pts=[(random.randint(0,self.WW),0)]; yy=0
                while yy<self.HH//2: yy+=60*self.ss; pts.append((pts[-1][0]+random.randint(-60,60)*self.ss,yy))
                pygame.draw.lines(s,(255,240,245),False,pts,max(2,3*self.ss))
        return name
    def _scene_name(self,t):
        for n,a,b in TIMELINE:
            if a<=t<b: return n
        return TIMELINE[-1][0]
    def _subtitle(self,t):
        name=self._scene_name(t); lines=SUBS.get(name,[])
        if not lines: return ''
        i=int(t*0.7)%len(lines)
        return f"[{lines[i][0]}] {lines[i][1]}"
    # ---------- frame final ----------
    def frame(self,t,dt=1/30):
        s=self.world; s.blit(self.bg,(0,0))
        self._caustics(s,t); self._embers(s,dt)
        name=self.scene(s,t,dt)
        cx,cy=self.WW//2,int(self.HH*0.62)
        self._sweep(s,cx,cy,520*self.ss,self.ch,t)
        out=pygame.transform.smoothscale(s,(W,H))
        if self.p['bloom']:
            small=pygame.transform.smoothscale(out,(W//4,H//4))
            big=pygame.transform.smoothscale(small,(W,H)); big.set_alpha(70)
            out.blit(big,(0,0),special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD)
        if self.p['ca'] and HAS_NUMPY:
            arr=pygame.surfarray.array3d(out); c=self.p['ca']
            arr[:,:,0]=np.roll(arr[:,:,0],c,axis=0); arr[:,:,2]=np.roll(arr[:,:,2],-c,axis=0)
            out=pygame.surfarray.make_surface(arr)
        if self.p['grain']:
            n=self.noise[int(t*24)%4]; n2=pygame.transform.scale(n,(W,H)); n2.set_alpha(26)
            out.blit(n2,(0,0))
        pygame.draw.rect(out,(0,0,0),(0,0,W,38)); pygame.draw.rect(out,(0,0,0),(0,H-38,W,38))
        f=pygame.font.SysFont('arial',16,bold=True)
        etext(out,f"BELENTANI MAX RENDER · {self.preset}",12,19,f,center=False)
        etext(out,f"TC {int(t//60):02d}:{int(t%60):02d}:{int((t%1)*24):02d} · {name}",W-12,19,f,PINK,center=False)
        sub=self._subtitle(t)
        if sub:
            p=pygame.Surface((len(sub)*10+40,34),pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.rect(p,(20,0,6,150),p.get_rect(),border_radius=17)
            out.blit(p,(W//2-p.get_width()//2,H-72)); etext(out,sub,W//2,H-55,f)
        return out

# ---------- export ----------
def _pil(surf):
    from PIL import Image
    return Image.frombytes('RGB',surf.get_size(),pygame.image.tostring(surf,'RGB'))
def export_gif(r,path='assets/sprites/belentani_cine.gif',fps=12,scale=(480,270)):
    frames=[]
    for i in range(int(24*fps)):
        f=pygame.transform.smoothscale(r.frame(i/fps),scale)
        frames.append(_pil(f))
    frames[0].save(path,save_all=True,append_images=frames[1:],duration=int(1000/fps),loop=0)
    return path,len(frames)
def export_frames(r,d='assets/frames',fps=12):
    os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
    for i in range(int(24*fps)):
        pygame.image.save(r.frame(i/fps),f"{d}/f_{i:04d}.png")
    return d
def export_mp4(r,path='assets/sprites/belentani_cine.mp4',fps=24):
    try:
        import imageio.v2 as imageio
        wr=imageio.get_writer(path,fps=fps,codec='libx264',quality=8)
        for i in range(int(24*fps)):
            import numpy as npy
            wr.append_data(npy.transpose(npy.array(pygame.surfarray.array3d(r.frame(i/fps))),(1,0,2)))
        wr.close(); return path
    except Exception as e:
        return f'mp4 no disponible: {e}'
def render_poster(r,path='assets/belentani_poster.png'):
    f=r.frame(13.4)
    big=pygame.transform.smoothscale(f,(1920,1080))
    pg=pygame.Surface((900,180),pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.rect(pg,(200,16,46,140),pg.get_rect(),border_radius=40)
    pygame.draw.rect(pg,(255,143,163,200),pg.get_rect(),width=3,border_radius=40)
    big.blit(pg,(510,880))
    etext(big,'BELENTANI · GUERRERO Y CANTANTE',960,940,pygame.font.SysFont('arial',44,bold=True))
    etext(big,'ES · CA · EN · MATES  |  MAX RENDER 2X BLOOM CA GRAIN',960,990,pygame.font.SysFont('arial',22,bold=True),PINK)
    pygame.image.save(big,path); return path

if __name__=='__main__':
    pygame.init(); pygame.display.set_mode((W,H))
    preset=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1] in PRESETS else 'MAX'
    r=MaxRender(preset)
    if '--gif' in sys.argv: print('GIF:',export_gif(r))
    elif '--mp4' in sys.argv: print('MP4:',export_mp4(r))
    elif '--frames' in sys.argv: print('FRAMES:',export_frames(r))
    elif '--poster' in sys.argv: print('POSTER:',render_poster(r))
    else: print('POSTER:',render_poster(r)); print('GIF:',export_gif(r,fps=10))
```

## 2) `render_farm.py` — GRANJA DE BENCHMARKS + MANIFIESTO GIT

```python
"""RENDER FARM: benchmarca los 4 presets, escribe RENDER_MANIFEST.json con commit git."""
import pygame, time, json, subprocess, os
from belentani_engine import W, H
from belentani_max_render import MaxRender, PRESETS, render_poster, export_gif

def commit():
    try: return subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','--short','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip() or 'sin-repo'
    except Exception: return 'sin-repo'

def bench(preset, frames=30):
    r=MaxRender(preset)
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    for i in range(frames): r.frame(i/30)
    ms=(time.perf_counter()-t0)/frames*1000
    return ms

if __name__=='__main__':
    pygame.init(); pygame.display.set_mode((W,H))
    man={'commit':commit(),'presets':{}}
    print(f"{'PRESET':8}{'ms/frame':>10}{'fps':>8}   capas")
    for p in PRESETS:
        ms=bench(p); cfg=PRESETS[p]
        man['presets'][p]={'ms_per_frame':round(ms,2),'fps':round(1000/ms,1),**cfg}
        capas=('SSx%d '%cfg['ss'])+('BLOOM ' if cfg['bloom'] else '')+('CA%d '%cfg['ca'])+('GRAIN' if cfg['grain'] else '')
        print(f"{p:8}{ms:10.2f}{1000/ms:8.1f}   {capas}")
    render_poster(MaxRender('MAX'))
    export_gif(MaxRender('MED'),fps=8)

"""CINE BELENTANI: reproduce la cinematica MAX en vivo dentro del Store (tecla 11)."""
import pygame
from belentani_engine import *
from belentani_max_render import MaxRender, TIMELINE

class CineBelentani(BaseGame):
    NAME='CINE BELENTANI'
    def setup(self):
        self.r=MaxRender('ULTRA'); self.t=0.0; self.paused=False
    def on_event(self,e):
        if e.type!=pygame.KEYDOWN: return
        if e.key==pygame.K_SPACE: self.t=min(23.9,self.t+4)
        if e.key==pygame.K_p: self.paused=not self.paused
        if e.key==pygame.K_m: say('Belentani, guerrero y cantante')
    def update(self,dt,t):
        if not self.paused: self.t+=dt
        if self.t>=24: self.running=False
    def draw(self,t):
        self.screen.blit(self.r.frame(self.t,dt),(0,0))
        self.screen.blit(glass(330,40,14,40),(W//2-165,H-58))
        text(self.screen,'ESPACIO salta · P pausa · M voz',W//2,H-38,self.f16)

if __name__=='__main__': CineBelentani().run()
